name: project7-2026-10-04
description: Project 7 Cablepark Rotterdam, ~1.5 h, 9 sets, with rider notes on jumps and falls. Sets 1, 2, 5, 7, 8 clean. Falls in sets 3, 4, 6 and 9 end the set late: GPS keeps reporting speed after the rider is down (set 4 revived by lookback for 21 s, set 9 peak speed comes from the fall). First fixture with motion slices around labelled kicker jumps, falls and a surface 360.

waterTemperatureEstimate.stationName: Krimpen aan de IJssel, Hollandsche IJssel

annotations.note: Clean set, 2 laps. Landed a kicker jump just after starting lap 2 (jump-set-02-lap-2).

Fell after the box at ~14:12:26 (fall-set-03). GPS still gave 21 km/h for two fixes, then 2-5 km/h and 200 m fixes, so the set ends at the GPS gap (14:12:35 replayed), ~9 s after the fall. End not asserted until falls are detected.

Fell at the box at 14:22:10 (fall-set-04) and swam. Coasted fixes followed (32.0 km/h four times at 63-200 m), then one 22 m fix at 21.5 km/h revived the set through lookback_same_ride (live: again at 14:22:24, 20.7 km/h at 16 m). The set runs ~22 s past the fall and averages 20.5 km/h. End not asserted until falls are detected.
1 lap. Fell after the kicker on lap 2 (fall-set-05); ride_exit_offcable ends the set within 3 s.

Failed kicker jump, crash at 14:37:47 (fall-set-06). The 14:37:43 fix hops 9 m backwards at a claimed 5 m accuracy (21.3 km/h, repeated next fix) and the next one jumps 14 m forward: the impossible track the rider saw. After the crash GPS still says 35-37 km/h, then repeats 28.6 km/h at 200 m; the set ends 7 s after the crash. End not asserted until falls are detected.

Kicker jump on lap 1, surface 360 after pylon 4, kicker jump on lap 2, fall at the box on lap 3 (15:02:43). After the fall the Watch keeps turning ~700 deg per 2 s until 15:02:54 while GPS reports 34-41 km/h: the set's peak (40.6 km/h) and sustained speed, and the session's 'fastest' highlight, come from that, not from riding. End not asserted until falls are detected.

annotations.label: jump
annotations.note: Rider: landed the kicker jump just after starting lap 2. Vertical acceleration ~-1 g from 13:59:20.35 to 20.92 (airborne), landing +2.5 g at 13:59:21.1; speed stays ~30 km/h.

annotations.label: fall
annotations.note: Rider: failed, fell after the box. Box hit 14:12:20-14:12:23 (6.2 g), down at ~14:12:26 (13 rad/s); GPS speed collapses at 14:12:28.

annotations.label: fall
annotations.note: Rider: fell after the box. 9.6 g and 21 rad/s at 14:22:10; swimming strokes (5-9 rad/s) from ~14:22:20.

annotations.label: fall
annotations.note: Rider: fell after the kicker jump on lap 2. 8.7 g and 18 rad/s at 14:33:38, speed 32 to 12 km/h by 14:33:40. The crash is ~45 m before the spot of the other kicker jumps in this session.

annotations.label: fall
annotations.note: Rider: probably a failed jump. Crash at the kicker at 14:37:47 (12.2 g, 26 rad/s, the session's highest).

annotations.label: surface_360
annotations.note: Rider: surface 360 right after pylon 4, just before lap 1 ends. Net heading -319 deg in 2 s.

annotations.label: jump
annotations.note: Rider: kicker jump on lap 2. Only short airborne bursts at the wrist (15:01:06.4, 15:01:07.3).

annotations.label: fall
annotations.note: Rider: lap 3 ended with a fall on the box. Box hit 15:02:43 (6.9 g), then ~700 deg per 2 s of turning until 15:02:54 while GPS reports 34-41 km/h; no fix from 15:02:55.
